chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 335: Ji Ning Forges His Sword Dao, Xuanji's Fear
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning refines his personal sword-intent, defining his Dao as 'grand freedom'. He dominates the final month of the Brightmoon trial, drawing the deadly attention of Ancestor Xuanji.
og_title: Ji Ning Defines the Line Between Madness and Freedom!
og_description: Ji Ning forges his own path with the Three-Foot Sword. As he cuts a bloody swath to the finals, a vengeful ancestor prays for his doom.
twitter_title: Ji Ning's Sword Dao is Refined! He's Not Just Clever, He's a Killer!
twitter_description: Ji Ning's Dao-heart crystallizes around total freedom. Watch him crush the competition and terrify a Pure Yang True Immortal in this late-tournament peak!

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary sword art created by Immortal Beixing, defined by its ruthless, unrestrained philosophy of satisfying one's heart through violence. The form is passed down, but each inheritor shapes their own intent.
The core of a Sword Immortal's being. It is the manifestation of their will, obsession, and Dao. A pure, unwavering Sword Heart empowers one's sword-intent and techniques.
A state of ultimate transcendence in Daoist philosophy, achieved by having absolute power and control over one's destiny, free from all worldly and karmic constraints.
A True Immortal who has perfected their Yang energy, reaching a state of pure Yang. In the Desolate Era hierarchy, they are mighty powers of the Three Realms, far above Celestial Immortals.
A Pure Yang True Immortal and the ancestor of the Shaoyin clan. He harbors a deep grudge against Ji Ning for the death of Shaoyin Nong and schemes to destroy him.
